newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's CEI to issue $75 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's CEI to issue $75 mln shares.

text.p: Argentina's CEI Citicorp Holdings said Thursday it had approved the issue of up to $75 million worth of new class "B" shares.
CEI said in a statement to the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange that the capital increase would be used to finance "the company's investment plans."

Together with other adjustments in the firms' capital decided on at Wednesday's shareholder meeting, this issue would raise the firm's capital stock by 15 percent. CEI said it would seek approval for the share issue in Buenos Aires and New York and or elsewhere abroad.
CEI added that it had decided to allocate dividends in the form of share allocations from its portfolio. It said it would give out 5.92 shares for every 10,000 shares held by shareholders.
